notes:
Passed with python3 -m mhs.driver check ... --backend fake (exit 0); evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. Model-authored by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 (run wC-035) and unreviewed; no human reviewed or tested it, no hardware backend is declared for this R0 simulator, and no hardware run was made. The card's mock_strategy.preferred is upstream-sim, but the upstream clone may not be imported, installed or modified here, so the fake backend is the package's own pure Python re-implementation of Environment, BuildingSimulation and Battery (fake.py); gymnasium and pandas are not importable where the gate ran and numpy was not needed. The upstream environment was therefore never opened or compared with the fake, and all numbers in fake.py (profile rows, defaults, noise constants) are placeholder test data. The driver is a GymnasiumDriver family config; env_id is left unset because upstream constructs Environment(building_simulation=...) and does not register a gymnasium env id, so only the package fake is served. Expected warnings, not failures: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the family bridge stores the seed for the next reset and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for inputs the bridge derives (reset.seed, seed.seed, step.ticks, step.action.values[*]). Only catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used; no extension ids, so there are no catalogue requests. NOT COVERED: cap.world.render.v1 is unbound (upstream render() is a no-op and the family bridge leaves rendering unbound) and no snapshot/restore exists (the upstream class has no get_state/set_state pair). The contract: action Box(-1, 1, (1,)) with source upstream_code (the bridge's derived limit names the space it read, FakeEnvironment:action_space; the clone line is cited in the Fact as building_energy_storage_simulation/environment.py:45), observation 3*n+1 values with the default n=4, reward -consumption*price, termination at max_timesteps, fidelity F0 analytic with timestep_ms 0 because the class declares no step duration (the gap in fidelity.gaps states this). The fake's seed support for randomize_start_time_step and forecast noise differs from upstream's numpy global generator and is disclosed in the determinism notes and gaps. gate.digest is the digest line of the last check run; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
